answer: WOA Cocktails is a luxury mobile bar serving Miami and New York. We rebuilt its website from scratch, with every page in English and Spanish.

paragraphs: WOA sells a premium experience, and the website needed to feel just as premium.
Customers and press needed a home online that matched the quality in the glass.

items.title: Rebuild from scratch
items.bodyHtml: Fully custom and hand-coded, with immersive visuals, smooth motion and a mobile-first layout.

items.title: Build every page in two languages
items.bodyHtml: Every page in English and Spanish, with a one-tap language toggle in the menu.

figure.caption: A WOA service page in English. One tap flips it to Spanish.

items.title: Set it up for Google in both languages
items.bodyHtml: So WOA shows up whether someone searches in English or in Spanish.

quote.text: Working with Button Up Media has been one of the best investments I've made for my business. They completely rebuilt our website for WOA Cocktails, and the final result exceeded my expectations.
